name: Suspicious Mors
desc: A fruit beverage in a deep red color. This murky, almost-purple drink is unbearably sour and bitter, as if it were made by pouring ink into suspicious water full of overnight fruit residue. It seems such a shame to pour it down the sink... but then again, drinking it doesn't seem any wiser.

value.text: Restores 26% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 450 HP every 5s for 30s.
